sn37.34:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sārādāyinī ca hoti varādāyinī ca kāyassa ||
sn37.34:1.3: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati sīlena vaḍḍhati sutena vaḍḍhati cāgena vaḍḍhati paññāya vaḍḍhati ||
sn37.34:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati || sārādāyinī ca hoti varādāyinī ca kāyassā ti || ||
sn37.34:2.4: ādiyati sāram idheva attano ti || || Mātugāmasaṃyuttaṃ vaggā tiṇi || ||
sn37.34:3.1: Visāradā Pasayha Abhibhuyya || Eka Aṅgena pañcamaṃ || ||
